title: Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts — Term, Waiting Period and Billing-Timing Schedule
content:
The day counts and term settings that apply to Homeowner Service Contracts are set per tier in this schedule. All counts are calendar days unless the line says months.

| | ApplianceCare | SystemsCare | HomeCare Bronze | HomeCare Silver | HomeCare Gold | HomeCare Platinum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contract term (calendar months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Waiting period after the contract start date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Waiting period after a mid-term upgrade | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Free-look period after the original start date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Cancellation administrative fee (USD) | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 |
| Refund processing window after a confirmed cancellation | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Payment grace period after an installment's due date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Suspension cure period | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Minimum renewal-notice lead time before term end | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Late-renewal grace period after term end | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Conversion continuity window after a real estate contract term ends | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Mid-term upgrade allowed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |

## What each line means

1. **Contract term** — the length of each contract term, in calendar months.
2. **Waiting period** — the calendar days after the contract start date before new coverage begins.
3. **Upgrade waiting period** — the calendar days after a mid-term upgrade before items or higher limits added by the upgrade are covered.
4. **Free-look period** — the calendar days after the original start date during which a cancellation receives the free-look refund.
5. **Cancellation administrative fee** — the administrative fee deducted from a pro-rata refund on cancellation after the free-look period.
6. **Refund processing window** — the calendar days after a confirmed cancellation within which the refund must be issued.
7. **Payment grace period** — the calendar days after an installment's due date before nonpayment suspends service.
8. **Suspension cure period** — the calendar days after suspension during which paying the full past-due balance reinstates the contract.
9. **Renewal-notice lead time** — the minimum calendar days before term end by which the renewal notice must be issued for automatic renewal.
10. **Late-renewal grace period** — the calendar days after term end during which an expired contract can be renewed without a new waiting period.
11. **Conversion continuity window** — the calendar days after a real estate contract term ends within which a conversion enrollment keeps continuous coverage.
12. **Mid-term upgrade allowed** — whether the tier can be upgraded to a higher tier during a term.

## Notes on the schedule

- Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum is the one tier on which the mid-term upgrade line reads No; on the five other tiers it reads Yes.
- Every day-count line carries the same figure on all six tiers; the tier held therefore does not change any of these counts.
